notes.title: Small Rebalance Patch
notes.content: [p][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Toned down damage values of both bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Player attacks and dodges consume less stamina.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pitchfork enemy no longer runs in place after attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Grapple hook no longer despawns if thrown too close to an enemy.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content: [p]The demo for Cerulean Singe has been released, please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530550/Cerulean_Singe/"]try it out![/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Delayed to Q2 2025
notes.content:
[b]Unfortunately, there have been some unforeseen problems during development where the demo has to be delayed until the next few months.
[/b]

The demo is still going to have everything previously promised, with the [b]first full level of the game with two boss fights![/b]

I just need a bit more time to iron out some bugs, optimize, and polish certain parts of the game. It's still progressing at a good pace, [b]I'm confident that the demo will be out in Q2 2025.[/b]

[b]Wishlist to get notified when the demo releases![/b]

notes.title: Demo - Info and Release Window
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481073/918007cdb582828a9e48654a89ee467efdf49f9c.png[/img]

[b]Cerulean Singe[/b] is approaching the point of having a [b]demo[/b]!

[u]Some information leading up to the release:[/u]

- The demo is planned to be released in [b]Q1 2025[/b].

- It will feature [b]the first full level of the game[/b].

- It will include [b]two polished multi-phase boss fights[/b].

The demo is in the later stage of polish with most of the mechanics and events complete. Pretty much all that is left is optimization, bug fixing, and playtesting.

[b]Wishlist to get notified when the demo releases![/b]
